Previously this sweep ran once per cancellation; now it runs once per calendar reference, so with N references each remaining recurring event is targeted N times, and repeat deletions would error (caught and logged via `logger.error`). The mechanism is visible directly in the diff, though whether the 404/delete errors are harmless is uncertain.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from a single `find(...)` result to `filter(...)` (array) and wrapped in `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside that loop, the recurring-event sweep branch (`if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)`) constructs `promises` over *all* `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(type.endsWith("_calendar"))` and iterates `updatedBookings` deleting each referenced event. Because this sweep is now executed once per `reference`, with N calendar references it will attempt to delete the same remaining events N times, causing redundant deletes and likely errors/log spam on subsequent passes.
